title: Which Buildings Are Artificial Intelligence-Ready? A Measurement-Based Assessment Framework for AI Question Answering and Actuation
abstract: arXiv:2610.09119v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) systems are becoming the interface to buildings, answering questions and controlling operations, but a building's readiness for them has not been systematically assessed. This study proposes a framework to quantify it. First, a building's knowledge graph sets two ceilings. The answerable-readiness ceiling is the share of operational questions its data could answer, and the actuation-readiness ceiling is the share of control actions it exposes. Second, a reference AI agent's accuracy on a fixed set of these questions shows how much of the ceilings is realized. On a simulated office, the agent realizes 0.62 of a 0.64 answerable ceiling, so missing data, not the AI, limit readiness, except in naming a fault's cause. Across 37 public real-building graphs, the median answerable ceiling is 0.16, and in 15 of 45, unlinked sensors lower it. The framework turns "is this building AI-ready?" into an auditabl

translated_title: 哪些建筑已为人工智能做好准备？一个基于测量的AI问答与控制执行评估框架
translated_abstract: 智能体人工智能（AI）系统正在成为建筑的交互界面，能够回答问题并控制运行，但建筑对这类系统的准备程度尚未得到系统性评估。本研究提出了一个量化该准备度的框架。首先，建筑的知识图谱设定了两个上限：“可问答准备度上限”是其数据能够回答的运行问题占比，“可执行准备度上限”是其暴露出的控制动作占比。其次，参考AI智能体在固定问题集上的准确率显示了这些上限被实现的程度。在一个模拟办公室场景中，该智能体实现了0.64可问答上限中的0.62，因此是数据缺失而非AI本身限制了准备度，唯一例外是在指明故障原因方面。在37个公开的真实建筑知识图谱中，可问答上限的中位数仅为0.16，且在45个案例中有15个因传感器未建立关联而进一步降低了该上限。该框架将“这座建筑是否已为AI做好准备？”这一问题转化为一项可审计的评估。
tldr: 本研究提出一个基于测量的框架来量化建筑对AI智能体的准备程度：由建筑知识图谱确定“可问答”与“可执行”两个上限，再用参考AI智能体的准确率衡量其实现程度；结果显示模拟办公建筑中AI几乎达到上限（0.62/0.64），而37个真实建筑图谱的可问答上限中位数仅为0.16，说明限制建筑AI准备度的关键瓶颈是数据缺失而非AI能力本身。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a measurement-based framework to quantify building AI-readiness by deriving answerable and actuation ceilings from a building's knowledge graph and measuring their realization with a reference AI agent, revealing that missing data—not AI capability—is the main bottleneck, with real-building graphs showing a median answerable ceiling of only 0.16.
